title: Keyboard: modifiers come up on focus loss, AltGr characters are typed

steps.say: Drive the keyboard layer with injected keys at the login screen, without a shard.

do.text: Alt, Ctrl and Shift held over a focus loss are released, keys already up are not released twice, an AltGr character as Godot sends it with the input method on reaches a text field, and Ctrl+C stays a command. Focus loss and the keyboard layout come from the operating system, so the focus-out notification is sent to the client directly.
